name: prompt-manager.vision-walk-prep
purpose: Return the bounded morning vision walk projection: agent-manager run volume as fleet health and ai-gateway total as inference activity; the scenario-owned form of library morning-vision-walk-prep@4.

window.description: Optional measures.v1.TimeWindowToken enum name, bound as {token: <value>} on ai-gateway/measures/total only; agent-manager/measures/run-volume takes no window. The ai-gateway CLI's lowercase tokens (this_week, last_7d, ...) are the same values without the TIME_WINDOW_TOKEN_ prefix.

assumptions: the vision-walk-prep heartbeat rejects a projection shorter than 200 characters or containing example.invalid; this program adds no placeholder values
an unavailable row is unknown, never zero
invariants: no binding with effect write or destructive is called
exactly two reads; only the first row of each is materialized
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path

signals.fleet_health: first row of agent-manager run volume (definitionId, totalRuns, terminalRuns, validity, ...)
signals.readable: count of the two reads that returned
signals.unavailable: count of the two reads that failed

fixtures.note: Both reads are guarded per row, so a refused or failed read lowers the status to partial (one) or unavailable (both) and is classified in errors[]; the status is never refused.
